instruction: Open the Week 5 (Unit Tests) page of the CS50 Python course from the sidebar on the course website in Chrome.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_tab_info' correctly extracts the current active Chrome tab URL via get_active_tab_info, returning a dict with 'url', 'title', and 'content'.

Metric 'is_expected_active_tab' correctly receives the rules dict {'type': 'url', 'url': 'https://cs50.harvard.edu/python/2022/weeks/5/'} as its 'rule' parameter (expected.type='rule' causes the framework to pass config['rules'] directly), and correctly accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'].
The URL comparison via compare_urls checks whether the active tab matches the Week 5 page URL, which is the core requirement of the instruction.
No postconfig needed — Chrome active tab info is always accessible and no UI dialog needs to be reopened.
Minor: instruction specifies navigation 'from the sidebar', but evaluating the final active tab URL is standard and sufficient for verifying completion.
